source_grounded_observation: Cycle 8 moved structural proposal selection and post-outcome credit into a native BODY compiler, but its proposal scoring logic remained fixed source code. Therefore the meta-mutation compiler itself did not inherit and improve a mutable decision policy.
hypothesis: A frozen generic meta-compiler substrate can store its routing policy in the nonvolatile COMPILER organ, learn diagnostic-signal-to-structural-proposal relations solely from prior fresh outcomes, checkpoint/restore between generations, and show three consecutive prospective gains on disjoint fresh hidden tasks without any source-code or workflow edits between generations 9, 10, 11 and 12.
hidden_world_contract: After candidate source freeze, evaluator-owned randomness permutes four opaque diagnostic signal slots onto four causal intervention regimes: GENERATOR_LANGUAGE, MUTATOR_POLICY, TOPOLOGY_REWIRE and ABSTAIN. Fresh task instances are generated independently for training and validation. Source code cannot know the permutation before hidden seed creation.
proposal_execution_contract: Each routed family must execute a real existing BODY intervention path: generator-language replaces GENERATOR with the compositional representation policy; mutator-policy uses NativeMetaMorphologyGenesisEngine to replace MUTATOR; topology-rewire uses MorphologyGenesisEngine to repair a typed failed edge; abstain performs no structural change. Regime success is determined by the corresponding behavioral invariant, not by route-name equality alone.
learning_contract: The initial mutable compiler policy contains no hidden signal mapping and fails closed to ABSTAIN. In each transition, one previously unresolved non-abstain hidden diagnostic regime is evaluated across competing structural proposals; only those past outcome scores may add one routing rule through an L6 COMPILER_RUNTIME mutation. The updated BODY is checkpointed/restored before the next fresh validation batch.
trajectory_contract: Evaluate four BODY states P0,P1,P2,P3 on fresh balanced validation batches. P0 is the frozen unlearned compiler. P1/P2/P3 each inherit exactly one additional causally credited routing rule from the preceding generation. No current-generation validation outcome may be consumed by that generation's policy.

controls.remove: Keep P0 compiler policy frozen across all four validation generations; frontier must not grow.
controls.wrong: Apply each learned outcome to a different opaque diagnostic slot; useful rate must remain below FULL and no bounded acceleration candidate may be credited.
controls.shuffle: Shuffle causal outcome records before compiler-policy update; useful rate must remain below FULL.
controls.restart: Every compiler-policy generation must survive independent SelfEvolvingResearchBody checkpoint/restore with identical policy fingerprint, morphology fingerprint, archive and selection behavior.
